name: plan-toggle
title: Plan Toggle
description: A billing-period toggle whose thumb slides and resizes, with a savings badge that pops and a price that rolls.

perf.budget: Plain views. The thumb moves on two shared values and the price on one; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The thumb jumps, the badge does not pop and the price changes in place.
a11y.screenReader: A radio group; each option reads its label and badge. The price is one text element, e.g. "$14 / month".
